directive.quote: Extend lane to actual BUILD in existing watch-the-service-itself-such-as-the-share owner, reusing current connect-a-service read_usage/provider DATA.

old_copy.deleted_with: Actual original-path retirement at published commit 4ffa1dc4a2265484f1ddf071e3dfc477e0e935f7. Retained read-only checkout and inert baselines are source evidence.

preserve: Choose the named request from the provider's connection record using current provider DATA.
Bind the reading's period and selected connection fields before calling the common renderer.
Place the token only in the declared header and parse the answer through the common HTTP executor.
Provider refusal is unread and cannot become zero usage.
allowed_deltas: The request DATA comes from its current connection owner; rendering and HTTP execution come from the generic HTTP owner.
The new fresh-reading tool uses selected-connection credential mounts. The old public readServiceWatch identity remains the retained-state reader.
The per-call environment holds only the mounted account ID. No operator environment, state store, schedule, alarm, notice, account write or price is revived.
Check real calendar dates and ordered inclusive UTC periods before reading held values. Missing account ID is unread without inference or caller override.
All GraphQL errors, missing account data, transport, HTTP, invalid JSON and invalid counters stay unread. Error text is not returned. Counter projection keeps empty lists and explicit zero distinct.
The private provider reader has a new container caller with declared imports, private field pipes and synthetic provider tests.
banned_substitutions: A copied query or second request-template engine.
Repurposing the saved-watch-state reader as a fresh provider request.
Returning tokens, raw provider errors, fabricated zero, prices or invoice claims.
Live provider, billing, account, grant or credential operations during source qualification.

provider_data_lineage.note: Existing dependency with a different original commit from the reader. Its query is not copied or changed.
